seo.meta_description: Medici is a mobile-first telehealth app for solo practitioners. $149/month includes video, e-prescribing, billing, and $1M malpractice coverage.

faqs.a: Mobile-first telehealth platform designed for solo providers and small practices. Lets you securely text, call, or video with patients from your phone without sharing your personal number. Includes e-prescribing, billing, and $1M malpractice coverage.
$149/month for the basic plan. Monthly subscription for individual providers. Affordable for solo practitioners without requiring additional technology purchases.

Video visits, secure messaging, e-prescribing, payment collection, 20-language translation (tap to translate messages), patient list import from your EHR, and $1M malpractice coverage layered on top of your existing insurance.

faqs.q: Does Medici integrate with my EHR?
faqs.a: You can import patient lists from third-party EHR systems, but it's not a deep bidirectional integration. Medici functions more as a standalone telehealth tool than an EHR extension.
